premises.statement: Average tenure may be calculated using only current assignments rather than all historical and current assignments.
premises.evidence_of_dependence: avg(date_diff('day',effective_start,coalesce(effective_end,current_date))) avg_tenure_days FROM assignments WHERE effective_end IS NULL
premises.alternative: The contract specifies average tenure "across all assignments" and places its derivation under mobility from "all assignments (historical and current)".
premises.reason: Excluding ended assignments changes tenure and can change health scores and performance categories.

premises.statement: Each current position contributes exactly one row to the enriched assignments used for weekly-hours aggregation.
premises.evidence_of_dependence: avg(coalesce(default_weekly_hours,40)) ... sum(coalesce(default_weekly_hours,40)) ... FROM assignments WHERE effective_end IS NULL
premises.alternative: The contract defines average and total weekly hours "over current positions"; multiple workers, profiles, families, or groups can produce multiple enriched rows for a position.
premises.reason: Join fanout or shared positions would inflate total hours and potentially bias average hours.

premises.statement: Counting enriched assignment rows gives the same compensation-grade frequency ranking as counting current positions.
premises.evidence_of_dependence: row_number() over(partition by organization_id,source_relation order by count(*) desc, compensation_grade_id asc)
premises.alternative: The contract defines most_common_grade as the "Most frequent compensation grade across current positions", whereas assignments also joins job families and job family groups.
premises.reason: Grades associated with more relationship rows can become the selected mode without being the most common across positions.

premises.statement: No assignment start or end dates counted by the last-year filters lie after the execution date.
premises.evidence_of_dependence: effective_start >= current_date - INTERVAL '1 year'; effective_end >= current_date - INTERVAL '1 year'
premises.alternative: The contract calls these events starts and ends "in the past year", which supports an upper bound of today as well as the implemented lower bound.
premises.reason: Future-dated assignments would enter hiring, departure, and transfer counts and could alter turnover and health classifications.

premises.statement: An assignment in another organization starting on the same date that an assignment ends does not qualify as a later assignment for transfers out.
premises.alternative: The contract requires "any later assignment in a different organization" but does not specify whether a same-day transition qualifies.
premises.reason: Strict date inequality can exclude same-day organizational transfers.
